newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nimes ex-mayor gets suspended term for corruption.
newsitem.headline: Nimes ex-mayor gets suspended term for corruption.

text.p: A French appeals court gave the former mayor of the southern city of Nimes a two-year suspended jail sentence on Thursday for using public funds to pay for domestic help at his private residences.
The appeals court also imposed a 400,000-franc ($67,700) fine and a five-year ban on holding public office on Jean Bousquet, a member of the centrist UDF who was mayor of Nimes in 1983-1985.
The appeals court ruling confirmed a lower court judgmemt that Bousquet was guilty of diverting more than on million francs ($172,000) in municipal funds.
However, it eased the trial court's sentence which had ordered Bousquet jailed for one year with an additional year suspended.
